name: work-mods
description: Vetted local copies of Claude Code mods for the work brain (read before install; never auto-update from upstream).

plugins.name: review-watch
plugins.description: Live line per running review (hamzafer/claude-code-mods, vetted 2026-10-07)

plugins.name: next-steps
plugins.description: 2-3 likely next prompts above the prompt, via a Haiku call per turn (hamzafer/claude-code-mods 5657c52, vetted + Codex-gated 2026-10-07); local: band lines wrap, no cut-off; answer-the-question first line; skipped when the reply ends in a numbered list

plugins.name: agent-radar
plugins.description: Live line per running subagent above the prompt; /radar pane (hamzafer/claude-code-mods 5657c52, vetted 2026-10-07)

plugins.name: belki-band
plugins.description: Belki tasks overdue / due today above the prompt (own build, 2026-10-07)

plugins.name: md-preview
plugins.description: Rendered pane of the Markdown files Claude edits, before/after; /md (hamzafer/claude-code-mods 5657c52, vetted 2026-10-08; local patch: GitHub API rendering disabled, 4 gh-path tests fail by design)

plugins.name: diff-fold
plugins.description: Folds every Edit/Write/NotebookEdit diff, files a Bash command edits, and Bash/PowerShell output over 2 lines (keeping its last line), to one transcript line (own build, 2026-10-08)

plugins.name: prismantis
plugins.description: Themed reply rendering (NahumLitvin/prismantis 0.12.0, auto-update dropped 2026-10-08); local patches: tool rows in a fixed grey via `toolColor` (default #444c56), inline code gets a background

plugins.name: session-tracker
plugins.description: Other Claude Code sessions in this repo above the prompt (working/waiting, latest task, age); /sessions (own build 2026-10-12)

plugins.name: reflect
plugins.description: Corrections become feedback memories: Haiku check per short prompt, band offers Save to memory (feedback-*.md + MEMORY.md line via noclobber create + append). Port of BayramAnnakov/claude-reflect b6c4232, Codex-gated 2026-10-12
